req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should not throttle requests below 60 per minute. This implies that a client should be able to make at least 60 requests per minute without receiving a throttling response. The tests are designed to verify this behavior by simulating different request rates and checking the responses.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_positive_case
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with the specified tasks.
actions: Send 60 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: All requests should receive an HTTP 2xx response.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_negative_case
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with the specified tasks.
actions: Send 61 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: At least one request should receive an HTTP 4xx response indicating throttling.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_boundary_case
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with the specified tasks.
actions: Send 60 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute, then send one more request.
expected: The first 60 requests should receive an HTTP 2xx response.
The 61st request should receive an HTTP 4xx response indicating throttling.
